main_idea: On-policy distillation improved GDPval performance across Nemotron and Qwen.
ideas: Nemotron gained a +20.9% net win-loss margin.
Qwen gained a +21.4% net win-loss margin.
On-policy distillation trains on the student's own work.
summary: The process cards and repeated takeaway add clutter; the graphic clearly identifies the GDPval results and needs no missing information.
